Hood9466
I have experienced lung cancer and did not want to smoke anything. The product did intrigue my addiction-prone self. I saw the dosage and I though if I wet the edge of knife blade and ingest it, I couldn't possible go wrong.
My wife discovered me in a non-coherent state and was concerned. She went to work and 8 hours later I was still out of it, plus my extremities were getting cold. She wisely called 911 and I ended up in the hospital, I woke up 2 days later and foggy as hell
I woke up 2 days later and foggy as hell
. I stayed in the hospital for 2 more days becoming coherent.
Lesson learned, this shit is way to potent to ingest orally. I did stupidly smoke a few hits afterwards but it produced more paranoia than a nice buzz.
I'm lucky to be alive. I'm not one to tell folks not to experiment, but in the case of cannabanoids pay real close attention to dosage, especially orally.
